7c67f079184fb7fb.description: Job description: Job Purpose To lead and manage the end-to-end tendering process for civil construction and EPC projects, ensuring technically compliant, commercially competitive, and risk-adjusted bid submissions. The role is responsible for tender strategy, cost estimation, proposal development, contract review, stakeholder coordination, and tender team leadership, with a strong focus on the Saudi Arabian market. Key Responsibilities Tender Management and Proposal Development Lead the complete tendering lifecycle, from initial tender review and bid/no-bid assessment through proposal preparation, approval, and submission. Review tender documents, specifications, scope of work, BOQs, drawings, and contractual requirements. Coordinate the preparation and finalization of technical and commercial proposals in collaboration with engineering, procurement, finance, legal, and other relevant departments. Ensure all submissions meet client requirements, tender deadlines, company procedures, and applicable standards. Cost Estimation and Commercial Management Lead BOQ analysis, cost estimation, pricing strategy, and preparation of detailed tender cost breakdowns. Obtain and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations to ensure competitive pricing and alignment with the project scope. Review contractual terms and conditions, identify commercial exposures, and recommend appropriate qualifications or deviations. Participate in commercial negotiations, claims reviews, change orders, and contractual clarifications. Risk Assessment and Bid Strategy Identify technical, commercial, contractual, financial, and schedule-related risks associated with each tender. Develop risk registers and mitigation strategies for major bids. Highlight critical contractual provisions, including liquidated damages, payment terms, scope ambiguities, and project constraints. Provide management with clear recommendations to support bid/no-bid decisions and improve bid competitiveness Post-Award Handover and Execution Support Ensure a comprehensive handover of tender documents, cost breakdowns, assumptions, exclusions, quotations, and technical clarifications to the Supply Chain and Execution departments. Support post-award clarification of tender scope, pricing assumptions, and contractual commitments. Coordinate with execution, planning, project controls, and contracts teams to support alignment between tender estimates and project budgets. Contribute to value engineering, change management, and lessons learned from completed tenders. Reporting, Quality, and Market Intelligence Maintain accurate tender records, bid status reports, cost information, and post-bid analyses. Monitor market trends, competitor positioning, client requirements, and opportunities within the relevant construction sectors. Establish standardized tendering procedures, review checklists, and quality controls to ensure complete and compliant submissions. Identify opportunities to improve estimating accuracy, tendering efficiency, and bid success rates. Qualifications and Experience Education Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. Professional Experience Minimum 18 years of experience in civil tendering and estimation. Minimum 15 years of professional experience in the Saudi Arabian market. Proven experience managing large-scale and technically complex tenders for reputable construction companies. Strong exposure to EPC tendering and civil works associated with infrastructure, building, power generation, water, defense, and oil & gas projects. Demonstrated experience leading tendering teams and managing the complete bid lifecycle. Technical and Functional Competencies End-to-end civil tender management. BOQ analysis, quantity assessment, and cost estimation. Technical and commercial proposal preparation. Tender pricing strategy and commercial evaluation. Saudi Arabian construction market and tendering procedures. Tendering software, estimation tools, document control systems, and ERP platforms such as SAP or equivalent. Saudi Market and Client Exposure Candidates should have strong familiarity with Saudi Arabian tendering procedures, client requirements, and approval workflows, preferably involving major clients and project owners such as: Saudi Aramco. Public Investment Fund (PIF)-related projects, including Diriyah and Qiddiya. Royal Commission projects. Saudi Electricity Company (SEC), particularly substation-related projects. Ministry of Sports, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Interior (MOI), and CEER. Experience with the above clients should be assessed against the candidate's actual tendering responsibilities and project exposure. Leadership and Behavioral Competencies Strategic thinking and commercial judgment. Team leadership, coaching, and performance management. Decision-making and problem-solving. Cross-functional coordination and stakeholder management. Planning, prioritization, and deadline management. Risk awareness and accountability. Integrity, compliance, and professional ethics. Continuous improvement and results orientation. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Timely submission of complete and compliant tenders. Tender pricing accuracy and cost-estimation reliability. Bid success rate and contribution to business growth. Guide and support Finance team members in their daily responsibilities. Work closely with other departments to ensure accurate and timely financial information. Qualifications and Experience A strong accounting background is required. 2-5 years of experience in a relevant accounting role. Experience within the hospitality industry is essential. Excellent analytical skills. Company Culture and Values Hyatt Place operates under the purpose of "we care for people so they can be their best." This commitment is reflected through values such as Respect, Integrity, Inclusion, Empathy, Experimentation, and Wellbeing. These values guide interactions with colleagues, guests, owners, operators, community members, and shareholders. Application Process Candidates with a strong accounting background and experience in the hospitality industry are encouraged to apply.

7c5e2f2c0a96a3b3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عبدالرحمن العبدالقادر للتجارة والمقاولات عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية ومتابعة الالتزام باللوائح التنظيمية في مواقع العمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق القوانين واللوائح والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية في المنشآت. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل وتسجيل النتائج ومقارنتها بالمعايير المعتمدة. تجهيز واستخدام معدات قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز، وتوثيق النتائج. متابعة معالجة الأخطار البيئية الناجمة بالتنسيق مع الجهات المختصة. تحضير مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات، وإجراء التحقيقات اللازمة وتوثيق النتائج. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتعليمات العمل الآمن والإخلاء. توعية العاملين بالتعليمات والإجراءات الخاصة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. فهم عميق للقوانين واللوائح المحلية والدولية المتعلقة بالسلامة المهنية. القدرة على استخدام أجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية وتحليل البيانات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتوعية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والإدارية بدقة. مهارات تحليلية قوية للتحقيق في الحوادث وتحديد الأسباب الجذرية. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب العمل في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب المتابعة الميدانية المستمرة لضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

7c893491d6ff019f.description: About the Role Air Arabia is seeking a First Officer A320 to join their team in Dammam. This full-time position involves conducting assigned flights in accordance with the Airline Operational Manual and relevant civil aviation authority regulations. The First Officer is responsible for ensuring the ultimate safety, security, and efficiency of all operated flights, providing support and guidance to the flight and cabin crew, and effectively managing emergencies and ad-hoc scenarios. Key Responsibilities Operate assigned aircraft according to schedules and approved flight plans, prioritizing safety, efficiency, and passenger comfort. Ensure all flights adhere to the Airline’s Operations Manual and regulations, continuously implementing and monitoring procedures for safe and smooth aircraft operation. Verify timely attendance, proper grooming, fitness, and legal compliance for self and flight crew before assigned flights. Conduct pre-flight briefings and ensure ongoing briefings are performed as per adopted procedures. Coordinate with co-pilots and the Dispatch Team before each flight to ensure flight/cabin crew are prepared with necessary information, including aircraft technical status, route preferences, weather, fuel, weight, and role distribution. Ensure efficient fuel usage during flights, within the safety constraints detailed in the Airline’s Operations Manual. Oversee required safety, security, fuel, and transit checks by assigned flight/cabin crew members before, during, and after each flight. Direct crew actions in case of safety or security irregularities and escalate as needed. Collaborate with Maintenance Engineers to confirm aircraft technical status and suitability for flight. Engage MCC and MROs for concerns, identify defects, and implement immediate rectifications where applicable. Ensure all necessary documents and technical logs are accurately completed and loaded as per Airline and civil aviation authority regulations, including the technical logbook, journey book, and reports. Ensure the Airline Operations Manual is distributed, accounted for, maintained, kept up-to-date, understood, and complied with by the Flight Crew. Stay informed on legal requirements from regulatory bodies such as the civil aviation authority and Airbus Company, relevant to flights and flight crew. Undertake additional ground-based tasks, such as Safety Officer or Security Officer, as directed by the line manager and in accordance with Part A of the Airline’s Operations Manual. Required Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 4000 hours of flying experience, with a preference for Airbus 320 aircraft. Experience with a low-cost airline is highly desirable. Acceptable industry knowledge of aircraft systems and operating procedures. Demonstrated knowledge and exposure to handle delegated roles related to security or safety, as required by the Airline and civil aviation authority regulations. Exposure to QA/Safety/Security/Audit procedures and practices relevant to Flight Operations. Capability to implement policies, procedures, and manuals according to approved standards and regulations. Ability to perform effectively in a changing environment with heavy workload schedules and ad-hoc scenarios. Composed, self-confident, and focused, with the ability to handle emergencies and threats efficiently. Proven skills in data analysis, identifying pitfalls, and recommending cost-effective solutions. Cost-oriented, possessing effective problem-solving and decision-making skills. High accuracy and attention to both results and details. Ability to leverage technical expertise and interpersonal relations to support company objectives. Demonstrated ability to contribute to and successfully deliver against business strategy and set KPIs.

7c8b2bb6fcce16cf.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking an Auditor to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on ensuring financial accuracy and compliance within the hotel operations. Key Responsibilities Verify the accuracy of figures, postings, and documents. Record, store, access, and analyze computerized financial information. Monitor and ensure the security of hotel cash and cash equivalents in accordance with money handling policies and procedures. Organize, secure, and maintain all accounting books and records in compliance with document retention and confidentiality policies and procedures. Prepare, maintain, and distribute statistical, financial, accounting, audit, or payroll tables and reports. Monitor statistical, financial, accounting, audit, or payroll tables and reports. Monitor and reconcile revenue postings. Follow and enforce all company safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management; stay informed of the presence of undesirable persons on hotel premises. Adhere to all brand policies and procedures; ensure a clean and complete uniform; maintain a neat and professional appearance at all times at the workplace; respect confidentiality in the dissemination of brand and/or hotel information; protect all company assets; protect the privacy and security of guests and associates. Welcome and receive guests according to company standards, anticipate and respond to their needs, assist disabled persons, and thank guests warmly. Use clear and courteous language in all communications; accurately and completely prepare and correct written documents; answer the phone using appropriate language. Develop positive and constructive professional relationships with peers; unite and assist each other to achieve common goals; listen and respond appropriately to other employees' problems. Comply with quality requirements and standards. Independently move, lift, carry, pull, and place objects weighing up to kilograms. Perform all other tasks requested by management that are consistent with the position. Qualifications and Requirements Education: High school diploma or equivalent. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the hospitality sector at Marriott International. The role requires adherence to established company policies and procedures, maintaining a professional demeanor, and contributing to a secure and compliant operational environment.

7c95c830c8cf7e94.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صحة المتحدة الطبية عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى توفير نقطة اتصال أولى احترافية للزوار والعملاء، وإدارة المكالمات الهاتفية، وتنظيم المواعيد، وضمان سير العمليات الإدارية بسلاسة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء بترحيب، وتحديد متطلباتهم، وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة لهم. إبلاغ المرجع المعني بوصول المراجعين والعملاء وتوجيههم إليه. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية، والرد على الاستفسارات، أو تحويل المكالمات إلى الأقسام المختصة. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية لجمع المعلومات المطلوبة. ترتيب وتنسيق مواعيد المقابلات بفعالية. تسجيل أسماء المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بلباقة واحترافية. مهارات اتصال ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة وقت جيدة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات المحددة. القدرة على استخدام أنظمة الاتصال والمكتب الأساسية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة عمل منظمة في القطاع الطبي. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لشغل هذه الوظيفة.

7ca04ba2bc209eca.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking an Electrical BIM Modeler to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves developing, coordinating, and maintaining accurate 3D BIM models for electrical systems, ensuring compliance with project requirements and company standards. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Electrical BIM Modeler is responsible for producing high-quality Revit models and preparing comprehensive construction documentation. This role involves active participation in multidisciplinary coordination, supporting clash detection, and facilitating design coordination throughout the entire project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain detailed 3D electrical BIM models using Autodesk Revit. Model various electrical systems including Power Distribution, Lighting Systems, Emergency Lighting, Small Power, Fire Alarm Systems, Public Address (PA), CCTV, Access Control, Data & Communication Systems, Lightning Protection, and Earthing & Bonding Systems. Produce coordinated shop drawings, installation drawings, and construction documentation. Generate schedules, quantities, and material take-offs directly from BIM models. Coordinate with Architectural, Structural, Mechanical, Plumbing, Fire Protection, and Civil disciplines. Participate in clash detection and model coordination using Navisworks Manage. Resolve clashes and modeling issues in coordination with engineers and BIM Coordinators. Ensure all models comply with project BIM standards, LOD requirements, and BIM Execution Plans (BEP). Update BIM models based on design revisions, RFIs, and site changes. Maintain proper model organization, worksets, shared coordinates, and file management. Support the production of As-Built models upon project completion. Ensure timely delivery of BIM deliverables while maintaining high quality and accuracy. Qualifications and Requirements 3-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Good understanding of electrical systems, construction drawings, and installation practices. Familiarity with BIM standards, BIM Execution Plans (BEP), and project documentation requirements. Required Skills Strong coordination skills. Effective communication skills. Proven problem-solving abilities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

7cab03a9372ad895.description: About Abdul Latif Jameel Abdul Latif Jameel is a diversified business with a significant presence across the Middle East, North Africa, and Turkey (MENAT region). With a history spanning 75 years, the company has evolved from a trading business and Toyota distributorship in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, to establish an extensive operational infrastructure and the largest vehicle distribution network in Saudi Arabia. Leveraging its automotive expertise, Abdul Latif Jameel has diversified into new sectors that contribute to the 'infrastructure of life' in the MENAT region. Role Overview Abdul Latif Jameel is seeking a Technical Service Operations GM to join its team in Makkah, with operations covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role is central to ensuring the proper implementation of Early Detection & Early Resolution (EDER) activities. The General Manager will be responsible for reflecting field concerns to manufacturers and contributing to overall customer satisfaction by providing timely and accurate technical assistance to service outlets. Key Responsibilities Improve and maintain systems for gathering technical data from the field. Supervise Product Managers in investigating high-occurrence technical problems. Communicate and follow up on top technical problems with manufacturers (TMC). Ensure the proper implementation of service and recall campaigns. Handle serious customer technical complaints related to products. Analyze Field Technical Report (FTR) data and review unusual patterns of warranty claims. Analyze parts demand data for recall campaigns. Participate in Conformity/Suitability tests, POD, POE, and other product quality activities. Impact and Strategic Focus This role directly impacts the proper implementation of Early Detection & Early Resolution activities and the issuance of high-quality Market Product Reports. It also indirectly contributes to customer satisfaction. The General Manager holds a crucial strategic role in achieving targets for FTR quality, quantity, and speed, and is responsible for organizing quality services with manufacturers and ensuring the proper implementation of service and recall campaigns. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to communicate new technical problems to manufacturers and ensure permanent solutions. Proven track record in providing high-quality technical support to service centers. Experience in launching service and recall campaigns efficiently and effectively. Working at Abdul Latif Jameel Abdul Latif Jameel offers opportunities across its international footprint, guided by values of Respect, Innovation, a Pioneering Spirit, and Empowerment. The company fosters a culture where ideas and people can thrive.

7cb9ead6dd2ed345.description: About the Role Tuwaiq Casting & Forging Company is seeking a Utility Operator to join the Maintenance Department within the Operations Division. This full-time position is based in Ras Tannurah, Eastern Region, and involves operating essential utility services for the plant. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Context and Purpose The Utility Operator reports to the Utilities Specialist and works as part of the Utilities shift team. This role is responsible for the safe, environmentally responsible, and efficient operation of utility services, including air, water, electricity, and wastewater treatment. The operator ensures these services comply with standard operating procedures and process control parameters, supporting the operational targets of various utility consumers across melting, casting, forging, heat treatment, and machining operations. Key Responsibilities Adhere to EHS regulations and guidelines, maintaining a safe working environment. Contribute to reporting and resolving near misses and incidents, and conduct site inspections. Maintain high standards of quality for supplied utilities in accordance with work instructions and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Coordinate utility sample collection as required. Complete and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly utility production and operation reports accurately. Monitor utility raw materials, consumable materials, and outsourced services to ensure smooth utility operations. Support maintenance activities, including taking equipment offline, isolating, tagging, and bringing utility equipment or systems back online after repairs. Assist with on-site and off-site hands-on training and coaching of new or existing utility operators. Conduct plant patrolling tours and complete shift inspection records. Report EHSS incidents and accidents promptly. Submit utility shift reports as required. Initiate ordering of required raw materials and chemical consumables. Raise maintenance requests to address equipment issues. Escalate serious utility operation and maintenance risks to the Utilities Specialist. Suggest operational, equipment, or process improvements. Qualifications and Experience Education: Technical Certificate or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Utilities, Industrial Maintenance, or an equivalent field. Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in utilities operation or maintenance in an industrial, manufacturing, foundry, forging, or heavy manufacturing environment (for Diploma or Technical Certificate holders). Minimum 6 years of relevant utilities operation experience (for High School certificate holders). Experience in the operation and maintenance of utility systems such as compressed air, water systems, electrical distribution, wastewater treatment, LPG, technical gases, pumps, compressors, chillers, or cooling systems is preferred. Work Environment This role is a full-time position within the Maintenance Department of the Operations Division, working as part of a shift team to ensure continuous utility service delivery. Application Information Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

7ccb7a654aebae9e.job_title: Senior Sales Executive Sea Freight & Freight Forwarding

The role requires a strong understanding of the Jeddah logistics market and established commercial relationships to support new business development. Key Responsibilities Identifying and acquiring new customers. Developing existing accounts. Preparing competitive sea freight quotations. Negotiating rates and commercial terms. Building long-term customer relationships. Coordinating closely with pricing and operations teams to ensure competitive offers, efficient shipment handling, and high customer satisfaction. Maintaining an active sales pipeline. Monitoring competitor activities. Identifying new business opportunities. Achieving agreed sales and profitability targets. Qualifications and Experience Proven sea freight sales experience. Strong understanding of the Jeddah logistics market. Established commercial relationships relevant to new business development. 5-10 years of relevant experience. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position located in Jeddah, Makkah. The role involves working within a team focused on international sea freight and freight forwarding services.

This full-time role involves supporting the hotel's sales strategy and contributing to the delivery of guest experiences. Inspire and develop the team through recruitment, training, supervision, and mentorship, conducting performance evaluations, providing professional development opportunities, and recognizing achievements. Inspiring others through leadership. A belief that teamwork drives optimal outcomes. A sense of ownership and accountability. A focus on the present, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment. 7cf443e18d5d0a6c.description: About El Seif Engineering Contracting El Seif Engineering Contracting has a fifty-year history in the construction industry, focusing on meticulous planning and expert execution across diverse projects. The company emphasizes excellence, integrity, and innovation, aiming to deliver sustainable and impactful solutions in construction. Role Overview: SR. ENGINEER - PLANNING The Senior Engineer, Planning provides expert-level planning and scheduling services. This full-time role, based either at the company's HQ or on a project site, involves leading the development of competitive tender schedules or managing project baseline schedules. The position is responsible for monitoring progress, analyzing deviations, and conducting delay analyses for Extension of Time (EOT) claims. A minimum of 10 years of experience is required for this position. Key Responsibilities Lead the preparation of comprehensive, resource-loaded, and cost-loaded schedules, specifically Tender Schedules (HQ role) or Project Baseline Schedules (Project role), ensuring alignment with project scope and strategy. Develop and integrate logical work sequences and Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) for all project disciplines. Monitor progress against the baseline, identify, analyze, and report schedule deviations, and recommend corrective actions or work-around solutions. Prepare and maintain Look-Ahead Schedules and Action Plans, leading weekly meetings to highlight delay risks and ensure accountability for mitigation actions. Implement standard delay analysis methodologies (*, Time Impact Analysis) to support the preparation of Extension of Time (EOT) claims (Project role). Review project documentation to identify and substantiate delay events (Project role) or to identify risks and assumptions for a bid (HQ role). Ensure all project controls data (WBS, CBS, budgets, schedules) is accurately set up and maintained in EPM/EPPM for tender proposals or active projects. Act as a key point of contact for schedule-related matters, liaising with tendering teams (HQ role) or project teams, clients, and consultants (Project role). Act as a subject matter expert (SME) by deploying on short-term assignments to project(s) providing targeted support during critical project phases or to help implement new procedures (HQ role). Provide technical guidance and mentorship to planning engineers and site teams (Project role) or to junior members of the tendering/planning team (HQ role) on scheduling best practices, project controls, and delay analysis. Act as a primary point of contact for schedule-related communications, ensuring alignment and clear understanding of project progress with clients and consultants (Project role) or tender schedule strategy with internal departments (HQ role). Contribute to the continuous improvement of planning processes, methodologies, and tools within the Project Planning Department, incorporating lessons learned from project execution or the tendering process. Benefits and Compensation This full-time position offers standard benefits including paid annual leave, public holidays, living allowances, healthcare coverage, and end of service benefits. Discretionary benefits such as a performance bonus, merit increase, and training and development opportunities may also be available based on eligibility. Salary details will be disclosed during the hiring process. Compliance Requirements Comply with corporate information security policies and procedures relevant to the role. Preserve the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Board and corporate information. Ensure access to sensitive information is restricted to authorized individuals. Protect organizational information assets from compromise. Comply with Data Protection and Intellectual Property Rights legislation applicable in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

7c230b3cbd3bdc8b.job_title: Architecture and Urban Planning Engineer - Fresh Graduate
7c230b3cbd3bdc8b.description: We are looking for a motivated fresh graduate in Architecture and Urban Planning to join our client's team. The ideal candidate should have a relevant bachelor's degree and basic knowledge of architectural design and urban planning. Key Responsibilities Assist in preparing architectural drawings, layouts, and design plans. Support urban planning and development projects. Prepare technical reports and project documentation. Assist in reviewing drawings and design specifications. Coordinate with engineering and project teams. Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Urban Planning, or a related field. Fresh graduates only; no prior work experience required. Basic knowledge of AutoCAD and relevant design software. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Good communication and teamwork skills. 7c2dc17e47507100.description: نبذة عن الدور يقدم معهد الخوارزمي للتدريب فرصة وظيفية لمدرب مهني بدوام كامل في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد وتنفيذ الخطط التدريبية النظرية والعملية في مجال التخصص، مع متابعة تجهيز وتشغيل الورش والمعامل. يتولى المدرب مسؤولية تدريس المواد النظرية، والإشراف على الجوانب التطبيقية، وتقييم أداء الطلاب وتحصيلهم. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مناهج علوم المهنة والتدريب المهني في مجال الاختصاص، وتحديد الأهداف التعليمية المباشرة. إعداد قوائم مستلزمات المعامل أو ورش التدريب، بما في ذلك الكميات والمواصفات، وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات. إعداد خطط تدريس المواد النظرية، وتصميم واختيار واستخدام التقنيات التربوية وأساليب التدريس الفعالة. تنفيذ وإدارة الدروس النظرية، وتصميم الاختبارات النظرية، وقياس تحصيل الطلاب. إعداد خطط الدروس والتطبيقات العملية، وتنفيذها وإدارتها، وتنظيم التطبيقات الميدانية للطلاب. تصميم الاختبارات العملية وقياس أداء الطلاب في الجوانب التطبيقية. تطوير أساليب التدريس وأدوات القياس والتقويم، ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في مجال التخصص. إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بأداء الطلاب وتحصيلهم الدراسي، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التدريب المهني أو التعليم الفني. القدرة على إعداد وتطوير الخطط التدريسية النظرية والعملية. مهارات ممتازة في التدريس والتواصل الفعال مع الطلاب. القدرة على تقييم أداء الطلاب وتقديم التغذية الراجعة البناءة. بيئة العمل يعمل المدرب المهني بدوام كامل ضمن فريق معهد الخوارزمي للتدريب في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. تتطلب الوظيفة التفاعل المستمر مع الطلاب والإدارة لضمان تحقيق الأهداف التعليمية والتدريبية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال مراحل المقابلة.

7c4291a25ee6148f.description: About the Role Tru is seeking a Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Technical Lead to join its Delivery organization. This full-time, permanent position is for a technical authority on large-scale Dynamics 365 retail programs, encompassing Finance, Supply Chain Management, Warehouse Management, and Commerce. The role involves solution design, development team leadership, ensuring code quality and platform health, and acting as a technical advisor to client leadership for programs handling high transaction volumes across numerous stores and critical back-office operations. Key Responsibilities Own the technical architecture across Finance, Supply Chain Management, Warehouse Management, and Commerce, including extensions, integrations, data flows, and environment strategy. Author technical design documents and review functional designs, challenging any design that may impact performance, scalability, or supportability. Estimate technical effort for new scope, change requests, and phases, and defend those estimates with client and internal leadership. Design integration patterns between D365 and external systems, utilizing DMF recurring integrations, OData, custom services, Business Events, Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, and Functions. Implement monitoring, validation, and error handling to prevent corrupt or incomplete files from affecting the ledger or inventory. Lead the technical workstream for Dynamics 365 Commerce rollouts, covering Commerce Scale Unit, Store Commerce, Commerce SDK extensions, channel configuration, and POS integration. Own security design, including roles, duties, and privileges mapped to the client's operating model, and alignment of role assignments with purchased license types. Own ALM: Azure DevOps pipelines, branching strategy, environment management across LCS and the Power Platform admin center, and release governance. Act as the final escalation point for performance issues, utilizing Trace Parser, LCS diagnostics, SQL analysis, and set-based X++ optimization. Lead, mentor, and review the work of the D365 development team; set coding standards and enforce them through code review. Represent Tru in technical sessions with client IT leadership and Microsoft. Qualifications and Experience 10+ years of Dynamics AX / Dynamics 365 technical experience, with at least 5 years on D365 Finance and Operations. At least three full implementation cycles, with at least one in a technical lead or technical architect role through go-live and hypercare. Expert-level X++: extension model, chain of command, event handlers, data entities, SysOperation framework, and workflow development. Hands-on Dynamics 365 Commerce experience: Commerce Scale Unit, Store Commerce, Commerce SDK extensions, and POS integration. Proven integration design at high transaction volume: DMF recurring integrations, OData, custom services, Business Events, and at least two Azure integration services. Security design experience, including mapping roles to license types and reducing license overuse. ALM ownership: Azure DevOps pipelines, LCS, and familiarity with the Power Platform admin center and Unified Developer Experience. Performance engineering: Trace Parser, SQL query tuning, and set-based X++ optimization. Strong functional knowledge of Finance, Supply Chain Management, and Warehouse Management, sufficient to challenge a functional design. Experience leading a development team and running code reviews. Confident communication with client executives and IT leadership. Preferred Qualifications Retail or grocery implementations with multi-store operations. Recovery or stabilization of a troubled D365 go-live. Working knowledge of Dataverse dual-write, Power Platform, and Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement. Reporting architecture: Electronic Reporting, SSRS, and data export to Azure Synapse, Data Lake, or Microsoft Fabric for Power BI. Certifications: MB-500, MB-700 (Finance and Operations Solution Architect), or AZ-204. Work Environment and Location This is a remote position within Tru's Delivery organization, working directly with client IT leadership, Microsoft, Tru functional consultants, and a team of D365 developers. While remote work is permitted from your current location, candidates should be based in or around Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, as occasional travel to client sites in Riyadh may be required for meetings and business needs.

7c47053d653da664.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مدارات الوسط للمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى المهندس المدني في هذا الدور مسؤولية دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسبة تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. فهم عميق لدراسة المواقع الإنشائية وتحليل التربة. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية وتدقيق المخططات. مهارات ممتازة في الإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع. نوع العمل والموقع هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المدنيين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور ضمن فريق شركة مدارات الوسط للمقاولات.

7ce49d27d7c41b9b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صديق ومحمد عطار خلفاء عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على بناء علاقات مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإدارة عمليات البيع والتحصيل. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، مما يجعله فرصة مناسبة للمرشحين الطموحين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. الغرض من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل هذه الوظيفة إلى جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات، وإعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين. كما يتولى مسؤولية التواصل مع العملاء لتقديم عروض البيع، إتمام الصفقات، متابعة العملاء بعد البيع، وتحصيل الديون، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير الدورية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، مع توثيق بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء من خلال الزيارات الميدانية أو المكالمات لترويج المنتجات والخدمات، وتقديم عروض البيع مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار المعتمدة ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المخولة، ثم إتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية المختصة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات أو دور مشابه. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل مندوب المبيعات ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي، مع التركيز على تحقيق الأهداف المحددة وتوسيع قاعدة العملاء. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة صديق ومحمد عطار خلفاء، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم مراجعة جميع الطلبات بعناية.

7c0b59a4aceee428.description: About the Role Catrion Group is seeking a Specialist, QHSE for a permanent position in Turaif and Dammam. This role is responsible for monitoring and maintaining food safety, quality assurance, and safety activities within the department and unit. 7c7e9fdb043aae09.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الأنظمة الرائدة المتحدة للمقاولات عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية المنزلية والصناعية والتجارية ومكوناتها بدقة. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة المطلوبة وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع مطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية وتشغيل دارات التمديدات، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، ومتابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بمواد وأجهزة التمديدات الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد الحلول المناسبة. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الكهرباء في بيئة عمل ديناميكية ضمن مشاريع الشركة في الرياض. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة الأنظمة الرائدة المتحدة للمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لتحديد الخطوات التالية في عملية التوظيف.

7c93f44bcc8455ed.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اغادير نجد للمقاولات عن مدير أشغال ومرافق عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في وادي الدواسر. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة إدارة المرافق في المنشأة، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية الحالية والمستقبلية، التصاميم، والأثاث، بالإضافة إلى تخطيط جداول الصيانة والتنظيف. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الخطط والسياسات والاستراتيجيات الإدارية العامة لمرافق الشركة، والإشراف على تنفيذها. ضمان الالتزام بقواعد ولوائح الصحة والسلامة والبيئة ومباشرة تنفيذها. مباشرة الأنشطة اليومية للمرافق في المنشأة، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية، التصاميم، والأثاث. تخطيط الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمرافق. مباشرة أنشطة الصيانة وتنسيق عمليات التصليح مع تقليل مدة التوقف عن العمل. اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم، ومراقبة أدائهم وسلوكهم مقارنةً بالأهداف المحددة. تخطيط أعمال الإنشاء والملحقات الجديدة، وإعداد العقود المتعلقة بالبناء ومراجعتها والموافقة عليها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المرافق أو الأشغال العامة. فهم قوي لمبادئ تخطيط المرافق والصيانة. القدرة على إدارة المشاريع وتنسيق الفرق. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية ممتازة. القدرة على التخطيط الاستراتيجي والتنفيذ الفعال. مهارات تواصل قوية وفعالة. القدرة على اتخاذ القرارات وحل المشكلات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في وادي الدواسر، الرياض. سيعمل مدير الأشغال والمرافق العامة ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة اغادير نجد للمقاولات، ويكون مسؤولاً عن الإشراف على جميع جوانب إدارة المرافق لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

7c9650ed43b72fbd.description: About PepsiCo PepsiCo products are consumed over a billion times daily across more than 200 countries and territories. In 2021, PepsiCo generated over $79 billion in net revenue through its diverse portfolio of beverages and convenient foods, including brands such as LAY’S ®️, DORITOS ®️, CHEETOS ®️, GATORADE ®️, PEPSI ®️, and QUAKER ®️. The company's vision is to be a global leader in beverages and convenient foods, guided by PepsiCo Positive (pep+), a strategic transformation focused on sustainability and human capital. Role Overview PepsiCo is seeking a Sr. Route Salesman to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is integral to the sales team, focusing on maximizing sales volume, minimizing product waste, achieving distribution targets, and ensuring high levels of customer service. The role requires adherence to operating procedures to maintain consistent standards across KSA and involves providing market information to supervisors for sales opportunity development. Key Responsibilities Sell the full range of products to an agreed list of customers, aiming to meet or exceed sales targets and keep product stales below the specified target. Provide customer service as approved by the supervisor, maintaining call frequency and adhering to the daily route plan to ensure customer satisfaction. Conduct daily and weekly vehicle checks as per operating procedures, ensuring the sales vehicle is clean and roadworthy, and reporting any defects or damage promptly. Agree on order requirements for the next selling period daily. Maintain individual customer stock levels to agreed requirements to minimize out-of-stock situations. Implement agreed in-store merchandising standards communicated by the supervisor, coordinating with company merchandisers where applicable. Advise the supervisor of any relevant competitor activity within the assigned area during daily debriefing sessions. Perform daily reconciliation of all cheques, cash, and credit sales, ensuring zero stock and cash shortages. Maintain a neat and presentable appearance at all times. Adhere to high driving standards and obey all driving regulations. Performance Indicators Daily/weekly sales performance against planned sales. Daily positive calls versus plan. Daily call sequence adherence versus plan. Product stales versus target. Absence of cash and stock shortages. Professional Development The Sr. Route Salesman will participate in training courses designed to enhance professionalism and customer service skills. Daily debriefing sessions with the supervisor are also a mandatory part of the role to review performance and market insights. Work Environment This role operates within a dynamic and collaborative sales environment at PepsiCo, a company committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. Employees are encouraged to embrace new ideas and contribute to a culture where every voice is valued.

7cbe3b0e1461f321.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ثرى الرياض للتجارة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع، بالإضافة إلى متابعة التحصيلات. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات التي تقدمها الشركة. بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمحتملين، مع توثيق بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء أو زيارتهم لتقديم عروض البيع وترويج المنتجات، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء، تسجيلها، توثيقها، وتوريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تساهم في تحقيق الأهداف المهنية والشخصية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

7cdc81f1e6305204.description: About the Role Emdad By Elm is seeking an Automation & Maintenance Engineer to ensure the reliable operation and maintenance of automated packaging systems for cards and vehicle license plates. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves machine setup, daily operation, troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and continuous improvement to meet production targets, maintain packaging quality, and ensure accurate matching of items with recipient information. Key Responsibilities Operate, configure, and monitor automated packaging machines, including feeding, identification, envelope insertion, adhesive sealing, label printing and application, and sorting. Perform machine setup and changeovers for various card and vehicle plate sizes, packaging materials, and order types. Diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and control system faults to minimize downtime. Inspect, adjust, and maintain sensors, motors, servo drives, conveyors, feeders, rollers, pneumatic components, and adhesive application systems. Troubleshoot PLC-controlled equipment and HMI alarms using electrical diagrams, machine manuals, and diagnostic tools. Maintain barcode readers, vision systems, thermal printers, and labeling equipment. Maintain, calibrate, and troubleshoot OCR, barcode readers, cameras, lighting, triggers, and related identification components for item recognition and verification. Verify accurate matching between cards or plates, recipient data, shipping labels, and assigned sorting outlets. Monitor rejected, unreadable, mismatched, and process-failed items, ensuring proper reconciliation between input records, processed items, successfully packaged items, rejected items, and final sorting outputs. Monitor and troubleshoot sorting logic, conveyor routing, diverters, sensors, and output lanes to ensure items are directed to the correct destination. Coordinate with IT teams and equipment manufacturers to resolve machine communication, data exchange, and software interface issues. Control approved machine recipes, parameters, configurations, and software settings, ensuring changes are authorized and documented, and maintaining approved backups in coordination with IT and equipment manufacturers. Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules according to manufacturer recommendations. Record breakdowns, maintenance activities, spare parts usage, and corrective actions; conduct root cause analysis for recurring failures. Identify critical spare parts and consumables and coordinate minimum stock requirements to reduce maintenance-related downtime. Monitor production throughput, downtime, packaging defects, and rejection rates, and implement improvements. Monitor machine availability and identification accuracy against approved operational and acceptance targets, in addition to throughput, downtime, defects, and rejection performance. Support installation, commissioning, factory and site acceptance testing, and production readiness activities. Participate in performance and stress testing, verify reject handling and functional requirements, and support punch-list closure and final production readiness. Train operators on machine operation, changeovers, routine checks, and basic troubleshooting. Follow machine safety, energy isolation, information security, and item traceability procedures. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of direct experience with automated industrial equipment. Experience with office printers, photocopiers, or general IT support alone does not meet the requirements for this role. Required Competencies Hands-on troubleshooting skills. Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude. Attention to detail. Safety awareness. Ownership of equipment reliability. Effective coordination with operations, IT, and suppliers. Work Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

7c21c0f538f8c35c.description: We are looking for a Training Specialist – Safety Trainer to deliver safety training programs, assess trainees, and support safety certification activities. The ideal candidate should have strong Oil & Gas safety training experience , with proven experience teaching and certifying students/trainees in industrial safety, emergency procedures, and HSE practices. Saudi candidates are preferred. Responsibilities Conduct safety training programs for employees, trainees, and students. Deliver classroom and practical training on industrial safety, emergency procedures, and HSE practices . Teach and assess students on safety procedures and required competencies. Conduct safety assessments, examinations, and practical evaluations. Issue or support training certificates/competency certifications upon successful completion. Develop and update training materials, presentations, assessments, and course content. Deliver training related to emergency response, workplace safety, and environmental awareness. Ensure training programs comply with applicable Saudi, Oil & Gas, and international safety standards . Maintain accurate training records, attendance, assessment results, and certification records. Monitor trainee performance and provide feedback and corrective guidance. Support safety awareness programs and continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure training is delivered effectively in both Arabic and English . Requirements Education Bachelor's Degree in Safety, Health & Environment (SHE/HSE), or Associate Degree / 2-year Diploma in Industrial Safety or Safety Training. Experience With Degree: Minimum 4 years of Oil & Gas experience. Without Degree: Minimum 11 years of Oil & Gas experience. Strong preference for candidates with dedicated safety training/instruction experience. Candidates should have experience teaching, assessing, and certifying students/trainees in safety-related subjects. Experience as a Safety Trainer, HSE Trainer, Safety Instructor, or Industrial Safety Instructor is highly preferred. Language Fluent in spoken and written Arabic and English. IELTS: Minimum 6.0, or equivalent TOEFL score: Internet-Based: 60 Paper-Based: 498 Computer-Based: 171 Preferred Skills & Knowledge Oil & Gas industry experience. Knowledge of the Petrochemical industry. Strong knowledge of Safety and Emergency Procedures.

7c92bbacc1b82e99.description: About the Role Qiddiya is seeking a Projects Manager to oversee project delivery activities for assigned assets, projects, packages, or site areas within the business unit. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Core Responsibilities Manage project delivery activities, ensuring alignment with approved design, schedule, budget, quality, governance, HSE, and project execution requirements. Review construction readiness inputs, including design information, procurement status, permits, logistics plans, technical submissions, and site access requirements, identifying gaps or risks. Monitor site progress, construction sequencing, critical path activities, and workforce deployment, ensuring compliance with specifications, Qiddiya standards, and regulatory requirements. Follow up on site issues, quality observations, and unresolved construction matters with project teams, consultants, and contractors. Monitor the performance of contractors, subcontractors, and consultants, ensuring alignment with contractual expectations, delivery requirements, HSE controls, and quality standards. Manage delivery interfaces across design, commercial, project controls, procurement, operations, asset management, infrastructure, and utilities workstreams. Coordinate testing, commissioning, snagging, defect close-out, authority approval, and handover readiness activities with relevant stakeholders. Develop project delivery trackers, action logs, progress summaries, and reporting inputs for assigned assets, projects, or site areas. Consolidate project progress updates, site observations, open actions, risks, HSE inputs, and quality records for management review. Supervise assigned team members or project support resources to ensure accurate and timely completion of project reviews, records, and reporting outputs. Generic Responsibilities Manage the implementation of the department strategy, ensuring alignment with Qiddiya's vision and mission. Ensure effective implementation of departmental policies and procedures, identifying opportunities for operational improvement. Manage the department's stakeholder engagement strategy, developing communication channels and tracking effectiveness. Oversee the department's budgeting process, analyzing financial data, supporting forecasts, and ensuring compliance with financial regulations. Drive continuous improvement of department systems, processes, and practices by identifying inefficiencies and implementing solutions. Translate strategic direction into actionable plans, develop SMART goals, and manage the talent management cycle for the department. Manage the development of a comprehensive reporting process for the department, guiding staff on Qiddiya's reporting requirements. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in project management or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage complex project delivery activities. Experience in reviewing construction readiness inputs and monitoring site progress. Proficiency in managing contractor and consultant performance. Strong understanding of HSE controls, quality standards, and project governance. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic project delivery environment. Additional Information The duties outlined in this description are representative; additional tasks may be assigned as necessary by management.

7cb21a7872bdc503.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجموعة الهناء التجارية عن أخصائي تغذية سريرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على تقديم المشورة الغذائية للمرضى وإعداد برامج تغذية مخصصة بناءً على حالتهم الصحية واحتياجاتهم، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالتغذية السريرية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة توصيات الطبيب المعالج لتحديد أنواع الأغذية المناسبة لحالة المريض الصحية، وتحديد قيمها الغذائية واحتياجاته من السعرات الحرارية. إعداد برامج تغذية مخصصة للمرضى، مع الأخذ في الاعتبار حالتهم الصحية الفردية. تقييم فعالية البرامج الغذائية المطبقة ومراجعة النتائج المحققة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل في مجال التغذية السريرية ومواكبة أحدث التطورات. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالتغذية السريرية في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء تنفيذ جميع أعمال التغذية السريرية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التغذية السريرية. القدرة على إعداد برامج تغذية متكاملة وتقييمها. معرفة قوية بمبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة في بيئة العمل السريرية. نوع العمل هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

7cd7a793cc0b4e82.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بيت الضيافة للاستثمار عن أخصائي فندقة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة أوضاع الفنادق والمساهمة في تطوير استراتيجياتها التشغيلية والترويجية، بالإضافة إلى تحليل التحديات وتقديم الحلول المناسبة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة استراتيجيات وخطط تطوير الفندقة، بالإضافة إلى القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية ذات الصلة. جمع المعلومات حول أسعار الخدمات الفندقية، والتأكد من مناسبتها، وتحليل خيارات الترويج لتحسين عائدات الفنادق. تقييم فعالية الفنادق وتحديد التحديات والصعوبات والمشكلات، واقتراح البدائل لمواجهتها. تحليل كافة المعلومات والتقارير، والاعتماد على نتائج الجولات الميدانية لتقييم الفنادق، وتقييم نتائج هذه التحليلات لضمان توافر المبررات المنطقية المؤيدة للنتائج. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالفنادق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول الملائمة، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المشاركة في تخطيط وتنفيذ حملات الترويج للفنادق بالتنسيق مع مكاتب السياحة والسفر. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتقديم التوصيات المبنية على الأدلة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة، كتابية وشفوية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل أخصائي الفندقة ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تعزيز أداء الفنادق وتطويرها. التقديم نحن ندعو المرشحين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في شركة بيت الضيافة للاستثمار.

7c7d832cc1fcaa5e.description: About the Role Luxury Goods Arabia Limited is seeking a GUCCI Store Manager to lead store operations in Makkah or Jeddah. This full-time role involves managing all activities to achieve business objectives, ensuring a high standard of service, and maintaining operational integrity. The Store Manager will act as a Gucci Ambassador, promoting brand values within the market. Key Responsibilities Drive and maximize sales performance to achieve overall sales budget objectives and monitor monthly profitability. Demonstrate sales leadership through active customer engagement, ensuring high service levels and meeting mystery shop goals. Manage stock levels in coordination with business departments to maximize full-price selling and align with new product launches. Train associates on current collection knowledge, brand pillars, and seasonal strategies. Communicate company KPIs and develop strategies to ensure performance standards are met. Develop and implement business action plans to enhance sales across product categories and client segments. Lead the team in establishing client relationships and supporting local events to promote attendance and sales. Monitor current fashion trends, industry news, technology, and competitor activities. Performance and Talent Management Conduct monthly coaching sessions and oversee the annual review process, setting employee goals. Identify development needs, create action plans, and build development plans for all employees. Attract, recruit, and retain a high-performing team, building a talent pipeline. Ensure a consistent onboarding experience for new hires. Manage staff allocation and scheduling to drive sales and ensure customer service. Partner with Human Resources for effective resolution of employee relations issues. Client Development Manage business objectives by utilizing a top client strategy to retain and develop high-potential clients. Promote brand awareness and capture market share through community outreach and sponsored events. Lead the team in executing superior customer service and after-sales experience to increase customer loyalty. Ensure the development and execution of company CRM initiatives, providing action plans to the team. Capture customer data for relationship building and personalized client development opportunities, monitoring monthly CRM database reporting. Operational Management Recap monthly store performance, reporting current business trends and competitor performance. Monitor store expenses and maintain the operating budget, aiming to reduce overall costs. Comply with Loss Prevention self-audits, cycle counts, incident reporting, and inventory reconciliations to keep shrinkage below target. Provide accurate monthly schedules based on peak hours to ensure adequate floor coverage and timely payroll submission. Support and maintain visual merchandising standards set by headquarters. Maintain organization of company assets according to back-of-house and front-of-house guidelines. Ensure an effective staff schedule based on traffic trends. Maintain the borrow log and consignment program in adherence to company policy. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience. The role requires a dynamic and inspiring leader with a strong background in relationship-building skills, capable of performing with high integrity in operations, loss prevention, human resources management, and visual merchandising presentation.

This role involves overseeing the daily shift operations for Housekeeping, Recreation/Health Club, and Laundry services, where applicable. The manager will work with employees to ensure guestrooms, public spaces, and employee areas are consistently clean and well-maintained, conducting inspections and holding staff accountable for corrective actions. This includes: Ensuring timely and efficient communication of guest room status to the Front Desk. Conducting daily inspections of guestrooms. Preparing work assignments based on lists of rooms to be cleaned and prospective check-outs. Managing inventory to ensure adequate supplies are available. 7c4bbfc6deb33bfb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الدر المنثور المتقدمة لحلول الاعمال عن فني تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم الرعاية التمريضية والشخصية الأساسية للمرضى، والعمل تحت إشراف وتوجيه ممرض مسجل أو أخصائي رعاية صحية آخر. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الدعم الفني للممرضين وأخصائيي الرعاية الصحية الآخرين في تخطيط وإدارة رعاية المرضى. المساعدة في إعطاء الأدوية الموصوفة والإحالة إلى أخصائيي الرعاية الصحية عند الحاجة. مساعدة المرضى في أمور النظافة الشخصية والأنشطة الأساسية مثل الاغتسال والحلاقة. المساعدة في الأنشطة اليومية مثل تناول الطعام والتمرينات، وتقديم وجبات الطعام حسب خطط الرعاية. تقديم الأطعمة والمشروبات بين الوجبات، ومساعدة المرضى في التنقل وتغيير الوضع. مساعدة المرضى في دخول دورات المياه وأثناء الاستحمام. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التمريض أو الرعاية الصحية. القدرة على العمل تحت إشراف وتوجيه ممرض مسجل أو أخصائي رعاية صحية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة والقدرة على التعامل مع المرضى بلطف واحترافية. القدرة على تقديم الرعاية الشخصية الأساسية بكفاءة. الالتزام بتحديث المعارف والخبرة الفنية بشكل مستمر. التطوير المهني يُتوقع من شاغل الوظيفة الحفاظ على الخبرة الفنية وتحديث المعارف بشكل مستمر من خلال دراسة المنشورات المتخصصة والمشاركة في الدورات التدريبية والمؤتمرات ذات الصلة بمجال التمريض والرعاية الصحية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق شركة الدر المنثور المتقدمة لحلول الاعمال. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.
